settings.precision: CUDA autocast BF16 with FP32 parameters
settings.timing: Five warmup steps, then twenty complete measured optimizer steps per case; a separate profiler step is excluded from throughput.

limitations: Throughput measurements do not evaluate story quality or validate large-batch training hyperparameters.
Input tokens count 255 next-token positions per 256-token packed block; joint generator and repeated backbone passes are not counted as additional input tokens.
GPU-only cost estimates cover the measured benchmark function and exclude startup, data loading before the timer, CPU, host memory, storage, and egress.
Maximum allocated and reserved PyTorch memory are not total device memory.
